cards.explanation: The answer is mercy, friends. The two blind men cry out, "Have mercy on us, Son of David!" (Matthew 9:27). They don't start with a list of what they want. Mercy is the whole request in that verse.

The answer is False, friends. Jesus goes into the house, and the text says "…the blind men came to Him." (Matthew 9:28). They had been following Him and crying out, and now they come to Him inside. Stayed outside? Not these two.
The answer is "Do you believe that I am able to do this?" friends. Jesus asks it in Matthew 9:28, before He touches their eyes. It's a short question, and they have a short answer ready.
The answer is faith, friends. Jesus says, "According to your faith will it be done to you." (Matthew 9:29). The two men had just answered, "Yes, Lord" (Matthew 9:28), and then He touched their eyes.

The answer is "See that no one finds out about this," friends. Jesus warns the two men sternly, "See that no one finds out about this!" (Matthew 9:30). The text doesn't tell us why He says it, so I won't guess. Just know the warning is stern.

The answer is False, friends. Jesus said, "See that no one finds out about this!" (Matthew 9:30). But "…they went out and spread the news about Him throughout the land." (Matthew 9:31). Two men who could finally see, and they did the opposite of keeping quiet.

The answer is True, friends. The text says, "And when the demon had been driven out, the man began to speak." (Matthew 9:33). Just before that, he was mute and was brought to Jesus (Matthew 9:32). The crowds were amazed and said, "Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!" (Matthew 9:33). I bet that room got loud fast.

The answer is amazed, friends. The text says, "The crowds were amazed and said, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”" (Matthew 9:33). They had just watched a man who couldn't speak start talking. Amazed is exactly what the verse says.

The answer is "It is by the prince of demons," friends. The Pharisees say, "It is by the prince of demons that He drives out demons." (Matthew 9:34). The crowds had just said, "Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!" (Matthew 9:33). Then the Pharisees give a very different answer.
